title: What fills each blank and box when brackets open?
description: Sentences with blanks and boxes have a bracket on one side and the opened form on the other. The outside number multiplies each term, and the sign between the terms stays the same.
teaching_notes: One idea: the number outside a bracket multiplies each term inside it, and the sign between the terms stays. Watch for students who change the sign or leave the outside number off the second term.

video_script.why: The child opens brackets in both directions and fills each blank and sign box.
video_script.substitution: The outside number multiplies each term inside the bracket, and the sign between the terms stays.
video_script.anchor: Sentences with a bracket on one side, the opened form on the other, and blanks and boxes to fill
video_script.payoff_line: Every blank and box is filled, and both sides are equal.

final_answer.spoken: every blank and box is filled, and both sides are equal

never_show: a blank filled with a number that does not fit
video_script.design: One idea: the outside number reaches every term, and the sign stays. Uses the method of the solved examples on opening a bracket. The sentences stay on the board all video.

narration: <bookmark mark='h1'/>This is a question from your book about opening brackets.
<bookmark mark='h2'/>Some sentences have blanks, and some have boxes for a sign.
<bookmark mark='h3'/>Both sides of every sentence must be equal. What goes in each blank and box?

narration: <bookmark mark='g1'/>The number outside a bracket multiplies each term inside it.
<bookmark mark='g2'/>The sign between the terms stays the same.
<bookmark mark='g3'/>We use this rule to fill every blank.

narration: <bookmark mark='fd1'/>We have to find each number and each sign.

marks.s11: the first sentence is written and its box and blank are filled
marks.s13: the plus box and the blank 8 are filled

narration: <bookmark mark='s11'/>Step one, the sentences that use plus.
Three times open bracket five plus eight close bracket is three times five plus three times eight.
<bookmark mark='s13'/>The box is plus and the blank is eight.
<bookmark mark='s12'/>Open bracket nine plus two close bracket times four is nine times four plus two times four.
The box is plus and the blank is four.

marks.s21: the blanks of the first sentence take the same number and 3 × 4
marks.s22: the bracket gets 13 and the last blank gets 6 × 4

narration: <bookmark mark='s21'/>Step two, the sentences with blanks and plus.
Three times open bracket any number plus four close bracket needs the same number twice.
<bookmark mark='s25'/>The last blank is three times four.
<bookmark mark='s22'/>In the next one, the bracket blank is thirteen, and the last blank is six times four.
<bookmark mark='s23'/>Three times five plus three times two comes from three times open bracket five plus two close bracket.
<bookmark mark='s24'/>Two times four plus three times four comes from open bracket two plus three close bracket times four.

marks.s31: the blank 2 is written in the first sentence
marks.s32: the blank 7 is written in the second sentence
marks.s33: the box and the blank 3 are written in the third sentence
marks.s34: the box is filled with a minus in the fourth sentence

narration: <bookmark mark='s31'/>Step three, the sentences that use minus.
Five times open bracket nine minus two close bracket is five times nine minus five times two.
The blank is two.
<bookmark mark='s32'/>Open bracket five minus two close bracket times seven is five times seven minus two times seven.
The blank is seven.
<bookmark mark='s33'/>Five times open bracket eight minus three close bracket is five times eight minus five times three.
The box is minus and the blank is three.
<bookmark mark='s34'/>In the last of these, the box is minus again.

marks.s41: the first sentence takes the same number twice
marks.s42: the number 3 is tried in it
marks.s43: the bracket gets 6 and the right side gets 15 × 7 with a minus box

narration: <bookmark mark='s41'/>Step four, the last four sentences.
Five times open bracket twelve minus any number close bracket needs that number twice.
<bookmark mark='s42'/>With three, both sides come to forty five.
<bookmark mark='s43'/>In the next one, the bracket blank is six. The right side is fifteen times seven minus six times seven.
<bookmark mark='s44'/>The next is five times open bracket nine minus four close bracket. The last is open bracket seventeen minus nine close bracket times seven.

marks.s51: the first pair of values meets at 39

narration: <bookmark mark='s51'/>Step five, check three sentences by finding both sides.
Three times thirteen is thirty nine, and fifteen plus twenty four is thirty nine.
<bookmark mark='s52'/>Nine times seven is sixty three, and one hundred and five minus forty two is sixty three.
<bookmark mark='s53'/>Eight times seven is fifty six, and one hundred and nineteen minus sixty three is fifty six.

marks.a1: every blank and box on the board is filled and the answers are boxed
marks.a2: the sign inside the bracket is circled beside the sign between the products

narration: <bookmark mark='a1'/>Every blank and box is filled, and both sides are equal.
<bookmark mark='a2'/>The sign inside the bracket is the sign between the products.
